notes.title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is available for pre-purchase now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499860/

"There's more to the world than this island... And we're going to prove it!"

Set sail on an adventure spanning past and present in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined!

As a bright-eyed young fisherman's son, you've lived your entire life on the peaceful island of Estard. Your journey begins with a simple question: is there more to the world than this small island kingdom?

On a quest for answers, you and your childhood friends discover the Shrine of Mysteries and are swept back in time. There, you uncover the shocking truth that entire lands have been sealed away by a malevolent force.

The fate of the world now rests in your hands.

DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined brings a timeless classic to life in a whole new way with charming diorama visuals, updated gameplay mechanics, and a streamlined story,.

For seasoned adventurers, rediscover a tale of plucky companions that is brimming with joy and heartbreak. For fledgling heroes new to the series, this is a great place to begin your DRAGON QUEST journey.


[h3]Early Bird Bonus[/h3]

*The "Seed of Proficiency" is an item that can be obtained by progressing in the game.
*These bonus items can be received from the "Claim Special Rewards" menu in-game.



[h3]Purchase Bonus[/h3]

Includes the full game, "Additional DLC Sets", and 48 hours of early access to the full game. Embark on an epic adventure ahead of everybody else!

[b][Contents][/b]
[list]
[*] DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined base game
[*] DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined "Additional DLC Sets"
     Additional DLC - The Road of Regal Wretches

notes.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince is out today!
notes.notes:
DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to Steam®!
 
Compose your very own team of monsters from across the DRAGON QUEST series and engage in thrilling battles against your foes. Recruit monsters from the wild world around you and combine them to synthesize new creatures as you see fit.
With over 500 monsters to choose from and a revamped synthesis system to explore, you can mix and match to your heart's desire to create your favorite cute critters and dastardly supervillains, as well as brand-new additions to the monstrous roll call.
 
Your quest to become the greatest monster wrangler of all time starts here!
 
(The network mode Online Battles from the console version, where players battle one another in real time, is not included.)

notes.title: Pre-orders now open for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince!
notes.notes:
DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince arrives on Steam®!
 
Form a party of monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series and enjoy fierce battles between monsters! Scout monsters you meet in the field to join your party or carry out monster synthesis to create your very own, new monsters.
Over 500 different types of monsters make an appearance!
The synthesis system of the DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS series has taken another step forward. Use new combinations to get all kinds of monsters in your party: monster mainstays, archfiends, and even those making their first appearance.

Set out on a journey to become the mightiest master of monsters! 

(The online battle network feature included in the console edition that allowed real-time online battles against other players is not included in this version.)

The first title in the DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS series, DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS, had brought its handy crafting features to Steam!

DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS is a block-building RPG that allows you to weave your own tale, and build to your heart’s content in Alefgard, a sprawling world made of an infinite number of blocks.
In the world of Alefgard, everything that you see is a material that can be used to craft various items, or build facilities that are essential to the lives of its inhabitants. Build your own unique buildings and towns, and restore Alefgard to its former glory!

notes.title: NetEase открыла еще одну студию в Японии для создания консольных игр — на этот раз под руководством продюсера Dragon Quest
notes.notes: В апреле сообщалось о решении главного продюсера Dragon Quest Рютаро Итимуры расстаться с компанией Square Enix после долгих лет сотрудничества. Однако долго он без работы не сидел.

notes.title: Умер легендарный композитор Dragon Quest Коити Сугияма — ему было 90 лет
notes.notes: Культовый японский игровой композитор Коити Сугияма, наиболее известный по своей работе над ролевой франшизой Dragon Quest, ушел из жизни. Причиной смерти стал септический шок. Музыканту было 90 лет. Информацию о его кончине подтвердили сразу несколько несколько источников, включая издательство Square Enix.

notes.title: Важный день для фанатов Dragon Quest: Square Enix расскажет о новых играх на трансляции по случаю 35-летия серии
notes.notes: Компания Square Enix проведет 26 мая презентацию Dragon Quest 35th Anniversary Special, которая впервые в истории серии будет транслироваться с переводом на английский язык. Раньше подобные мероприятия организовывались исключительно для японских пользователей.

notes.title: Стример отказался спать, чтобы пройти все части Dragon Quest за один заход
notes.notes: Прохождение одной японской ролевой игры может занять десятки, а то и сотни часов, однако стримеру Akino удалось пройти все основные части Dragon Quest в рамках одного стрим-марафона. На достижение поставленной цели у него ушло 85 часов и 15 минут, а чтобы не уснуть, он употреблял энергетические напитки и использовал аудио-программу.

notes.title: Король традиционных JRPG: Обзор Dragon Quest XI S: Echoes of An Elusive Age - Definitive Edition
notes.notes: Справедливость восторжествовала, и спустя более года после появления Dragon Quest XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition на Nintendo Switch владельцы PS4, PC, а с ними и Xbox One, наконец, получают доработанный релиз одиннадцатой части Dragon Quest. Флагманская серия жанра радует нас уже больше тридцати лет, постоянно привнося что-то свежее в устоявшийся рецепт, словно Марио от мира японских ролевых игр. Dragon Quest XI стала настоящим откровением, и теперь все геймеры смогут насладиться ею со всеми новшествами всласть.

notes.title: DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition Out Today
notes.notes:
DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition is Out Today!

Enjoy the new content and features of DRAGON QUEST XI S today. Play in 2D or 3D mode, experience new scenarios, Japanese voices, orchestral music and much more. 

[previewyoutube=tOXK1rq1Y9k;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Story[/h2]

It was the day that you, the hero of this tale celebrated your 16th Birthday.
Together with your childhood friend Gemma, you climbed to the top of Cobblestone Tor, to perform the coming of age rites that are customary in your village. However, a mysterious incident lead you to discover that you are the reincarnation of the legendary "Luminary".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365799/22786ccb22fc27688b790785100e4ad0709cc771.jpg[/img]

[h2]What exactly is the "Luminary"?[/h2]

You decide to leave the village and set out on a journey into the unknown world to seek the answer.
However, the people seem to have no welcome for a young Luminary and decry you as the spawn of the devil, sealing your fate to be an outcast...

Jump into the beautiful world of Erdrea, unravel the mystery of your past and claim some bonus content rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365799/a3ac2ca53f0a525e4f3aa2cc6825ae1d0d523824.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy your time with DRAGON QUEST XI S.

notes.title: Dragon Quest XI Definitive Edition arrives on PC today
notes.notes:
It’s been two years since Dragon Quest XI: Echoes Of An Elusive Age first came to PC, and today its shiny new Definitive Edition arrives. This version of the game allows you to turn on a “retro” mode to play the 3D JRPG as a 16-bit 2D game instead. I feel like downgrading the graphics is the opposite to what a “Definitive Edition” should do, but it sounds fun throwback nonetheless.

(more…)

notes.title: Doom Eternal and Va-11 Hall-A hit Xbox Game Pass for PC tomorrow
notes.notes:
Xbox Game Pass for PC continues to collect some absolute belters, with the likes of Doom Eternal, Va-11 Hall-A, Yes, Your Grace and Call Of The Sea headlining its new additions this month.

There’s loads more coming throughout December, too. Looking down the list we’ve got Greedfall, Unto The End and Yooka-Laylee And The Impossible Lair. Genuinely, if you’ve been looking for a good time to try out the Game Pass for its cheapo £1 / $1 first month deal, I think now might be your chance.

(more…)

notes.title: Dragon Quest XI Definitive Edition has a free 10-hour demo
notes.notes:
Ahead of its release on PC next month, the horrifically long-named Dragon Quest XI S: Echoes Of An Elusive Age – Definitive Edition has a free demo you can play right now. It lets you explore the first 10 hours of the turn-based RPG, and all your progress will carry over into the full game if you end up buying it after.

(more…)

notes.title: Try out the free DRAGON QUEST XI S DEMO!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Today we’re pleased to announce that the free DRAGON QUEST XI S DEMO is available to download right now.

Join a young hero as he takes his first steps towards becoming the Luminary, a legendary hero destined to save Erdrea—and then carry over your progress into the full game when it releases on December 4, 2020!

This demo will give you a generous glimpse of the epic tale that awaits you in DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition. Enjoy the beginning of the game in 3D for up to 10 hours of content! 

You'll get to experience some of the new features added to this version of the game such as the Symphonic Soundtrack, Japanese voice over, the ability to speed up battles, and the new Photo Mode.   

Samantha from our great Square Enix America Community Team will host a livestream here on Nov. 2nd - 11am PDT, come and join us!

BONUS*: Complete the demo and be rewarded with x3 “Seed of Skill” - quite handy when you'll continue your adventure in the full game.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365799/9edebdc145a57c94c14b93a15fc793248337f5ae.png[/img]

Don't wait any longer to experience the beginning of an all-new adventure: play the free demo now! 

Stay up to date with all the latest DRAGON QUEST news and updates. Be sure to follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram! @DragonQuest

[url=https://youtu.be/68MBqA5IX8Q]https://youtu.be/68MBqA5IX8Q[/url]

*NOTE: Due to the way Steam works, you will be unable to continue to play the demo after purchasing the full game. Please be aware that if you purchase the full game before completing the demo, you will no longer be able to receive the completion bonus from the demo.

notes.title: Dragon Quest XI's Definitive Edition is coming to PC
notes.notes:
Two years after Dragon Quest XI: Echoes Of An Elusive Age hit PC, a new edition is coming round with additions including new quests and the option to play this 3D JRPG as a retro-styled 16-bit 2D game. Pleasingly daft, that. Bearing the triple-barrelled name Dragon Quest XI S: Echoes Of An Elusive Age – Definitive Edition, this new version debuted on Nintendo Switch in September 2019, and will be coming to PC on December 4th.

(more…)
